gnosh prompt export

  Write the built-in instructions to that folder, as a file to edit.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh prompt export [flags] [name]

Flags
  --force
      Write the file even if one is already there. (Not built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
